parameter_semantics: object_pose_field selects the observed manipulated block used for proximity, motion and clearance features; destination_pose_field selects the observed SE(3) frame for learned targets; tunnel_clearance_m is world z=0.16 m and enters both features and the conservative decoder guard. Bindings use object_pose, target_pose and 0.16.
output_semantics: Each slot is [destination-frame TCP x,y,z metres, destination-frame TCP rotation 6D as first two columns, gripper scalar]. decode composes the represented pose with the freshly observed target_pose. If and only if observed fingers are closed, TCP is within 0.06 m of the block and block z is below tunnel_clearance_m, a deterministic projection caps premature +world-x transfer to object_x+0.03 m and keeps y inside the object-centre tunnel lane while the block is inside tunnel x. Rotation is unchanged. The resulting world TCP pose goes through panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. Slots are t-1..t+14; execution uses 1..8.

conversion_check.description: Destination-frame encode/decode must recover demonstrated FK TCP and gripper within 0.01 maximum metres/radians/scalar. The declared guard is inactive on valid demonstrated targets; any projection and all IK residuals are reported.

cut_relation: Keeps all [300,840) actions for each trajectory, including [300,440) predecessor and [680,840) successor overlap. The only nonlearned refinement is the declared low-clearance projection; it does not add task waypoints.
